lines: Bondrail uses Envio to turn onchain payments into revenue history investors can inspect. This previously recorded testnet trade generated a fee and automatically repaid part of a revenue bond.
The transaction receipt shows the actual Revenue event: a one cent fee, with a quarter of that fee directed to the bond. We will follow this exact transaction into Envio.
Here we query the deployed HyperIndex endpoint used by Bondrail. The filter is the same transaction hash. This is a fresh, read only request, returning the indexed payment and its revenue split.
The returned payment is classified as native. The split matches the receipt: ten thousand base units in revenue, with twenty five hundred sent to the bond. These are six decimal test U S D C amounts.
Back in the live product, Envio's aggregates power this business's revenue history, payment totals and payer breakdown. The account now shows two payments and two cents in revenue.

Investors can inspect who paid and whether a funding link was detected. No link found is not proof of an independent customer. This is controlled testnet activity, demonstrating how indexed data drives the product.
